info.name: Storefront API
info.description:
Postman collection for the fullstack-ecommerce backend (app/backend).

**Getting started**
1. Start the backend (`npm run watch`) — default `baseUrl` is `http://localhost:3000`; every API request adds the `/api/v1` prefix itself.
2. Run **Auth → Register** (or **Login**). The test script stores `accessToken`, `refreshToken` and `userId` in collection variables.
3. Every other request inherits Bearer auth from the collection using `{{accessToken}}`.
4. Create requests (product, order, cart item, address) save the new id into `productId`, `orderId`, `cartItemId`, `addressId`.

Access tokens expire after 15 minutes by default — run **Auth → Refresh Token** to rotate both tokens.

Auth routes `register`, `login` and `refresh` are rate limited to 20 requests per 15 minutes.

**Admin API**
1. Create the first admin with `npm run seed:admin` (reads `ADMIN_USERNAME` / `ADMIN_PASSWORD` from `.env`).
2. Set the `adminUsername` / `adminPassword` collection variables to match and run **Auth → Login (admin)**. It stores `adminAccessToken`, `adminRefreshToken` and `adminUserId`.
3. Every request in the **Admin** folder (and the product write requests) authenticates with `{{adminAccessToken}}`.
4. Set `targetUserId` to the customer you want to act on; admin create requests save `adminOrderId`, `adminCartItemId`, `adminAddressId`.

Product create/update/delete and `GET`/`POST /users` require an admin token; a customer token gets `403`.

request.description: Returns `{ message: "Storefront API is running!" }`.
Creates an account and returns `user`, `accessToken`, `refreshToken`. Password must be at least 8 characters. Returns 409 if the username exists — use Login instead.
Logs in the admin account created by `npm run seed:admin` and stores `adminAccessToken`, `adminRefreshToken`, `adminUserId`.
Rotates the refresh token: the old one is deleted and a new access + refresh token pair is returned.
Revokes the given refresh token.
Revokes every refresh token for the current user.

item.name: Users

request.description: Admin only.
Your own account, including the 5 most recent purchases as `recentPurchases`. Returns 403 for another user's id.
All four fields are required. Admin only.
Send at least one of `firstName`, `lastName`, `username`, `password`. Only works on your own account (403 otherwise).
Deletes your own account (403 for another user's id). Register again afterwards to keep using the collection.

item.description: `GET /users` and `POST /users` require an admin token (`{{adminAccessToken}}`, see **Auth → Login (admin)**). Get, update and delete only work on your own account (`{{userId}}` is saved by Login/Register); another user's id returns 403 unless the token belongs to an admin.

item.name: Products

query.description: Case-insensitive match on name or description

request.description: One page of matching products. meta.total counts every match, so keep raising offset while offset + data.length < meta.total.
Every distinct category, sorted.
Ranked by total quantity ordered.
`name` and `price` (non-negative number) are required; everything else is optional.

request.description: Send at least one product field.

item.description: Reads work with any signed-in user. Create, bulk create, update and delete require an admin token (`{{adminAccessToken}}`, see **Auth → Login (admin)**); a customer token gets 403.

item.name: Orders

request.description: Returns only your own orders.
`status` must be `active` or `complete`. `userId` is optional and must be your own id.
Creates an order for the token user. `userId` is optional (defaults to you; 403 if it's another user). `status` defaults to `active`.
Returns 200 on success.
`:userId` must be your own id (403 otherwise).
`:userId` must be your own id (403 otherwise).

item.description: Orders are scoped to the user from the access token. Another user's order id returns 404; another user's id in the URL, query or body returns 403.

item.name: Cart
item.description: Cart routes act on the user from the access token.

request.description: Increments quantity if the same product + type already exists. `quantity` defaults to 1. `typeId`, `selectedType`, `shopId`, `shopName` are optional.
Creates a completed order from `items` and clears the cart.

item.name: Addresses
item.description: Address routes act on the user from the access token.

request.description: `fullName`, `address`, `city` are required. `label` is `home` | `work` | `other` (defaults to `home`).

item.name: Admin
item.description: Every request here requires an admin token (`{{adminAccessToken}}`) — the role is re-checked against the database on each call, and all non-GET requests are written to the server audit log. List endpoints accept `limit` (1–100, default 50) and `offset`. Set `targetUserId` to the customer you want to act on.
